Docket No. 21-0436 

ORDER NO. 9877 
SUSPENDING PROCEDURAL DEADLINES 
PENDING CONSIDERATION OF SETTLEMENT 
WHEREAS, on June 23, 2021, the Commission entered Order No. 9831, which (a) 
appointed the undersigned to serve as Hearing Examiner for this Docket, and (b) adopted a 
procedural schedule related to proceedings in this Docket; 
WHEREAS, on August 3, 2021, upon the joint request of Applicants, Veolia Environment 
S.A., Veolia North America, Inc., SUEZ S.A., and SUEZ Water Delaware Inc. (collectively the 
“Joint Applicants”), Commission Staff (“Staff”), and the Division of the Public Advocate 
(“DPA”), the undersigned Hearing Examiner entered Order No. 9852, extending certain deadlines 
in the case in order to allow time for the parties to engage in settlement discussions as contemplated 
by Order No. 9831; 
WHEREAS, on August 18, 2021, upon the joint request of the Joint Applicants, 
Commission Staff and the DPA, the undersigned Hearing Examiner entered Order No. 9870, 
further extending certain deadlines; 
WHEREAS, by email message sent to the Hearing Examiner on August 27, 2021, counsel 
for the Joint Applicants advised that the parties remained actively engaged in settlement 

2 

discussions and anticipated that they were close to a reaching a resolution of this matter by 
settlement, and requested, on behalf of the Joint Applicants, Staff and the DPA, that the deadlines 
in the schedule be suspended while the parties and their counsel attempted to finalize an agreement 
in principle to settle and resolve this matter; 
WHEREAS, counsel for the Joint Applicants, Staff and the DPA all agree that the Hearing 
Examiner is authorized to suspend the deadlines in the schedule as requested, by virtue of the 
powers delegated to the Hearing Examiner in Paragraph 2 of Order No. 9831, and under Section 
1.9.2 of the Rules of Practice and Procedure of the Commission, 26 Del. Admin. Code § 1001-
1.9.2; and 
WHEREAS, there is good cause to suspend the deadlines in Order No. 9831, to allow the 
parties time to finalize a settlement in principle that will resolve the issues raised in this docket, 

NOW, THEREFORE, this 31st day of August 2021, pursuant to the authority granted to 
me in PSC Order No. 9831, dated June 23, 2021, this Hearing Examiner, having considered the 
application of the Joint Applicants, Staff and DPA as described above, orders as follows: 
1. 
The joint request of the Joint Applicants, Staff and DPA to suspend all procedural 
deadlines in this proceeding is granted. 
2. 
Counsel for the parties shall promptly report to the Hearing Examiner when they 
have reached an agreement in principle to settle the issues presented in this Docket. 
3. 
If an agreement in principle to settle this matter is reached, the Joint Applicants 
intend to present the terms of the settlement for Commission approval through a Final Order at the 
October 6, 2021 public meeting. 

3 

4. 
If the parties are unable to reach an agreement in principle to settle this matter, 
counsel for the Joint Applicants, Staff and the DPA shall confer on a proposal to revise the schedule 
for presenting the Application to the Commission. 
BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION 

/s/ Glenn C. Kenton 
Glenn C. Kenton 
Hearing Examiner 

Dated: August 31, 2021
